description: The theming scope of Accessible first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: theming.roles
answers.why: One brand, so only the mode changes.

answers.question: theming.values
answers.why: Light and dark ship as standard; both hold AAA text.

usage.use: The dark semantic mode, or high contrast
usage.why: People pick the mode they can read.
